📊 Her husband attached a stool leg to a drill to treat a rugby injury. Five years later, they’d built an £8M-a-year sports recovery brand 🤯

We sat down with Lottie Whyte [@lottiewhyte] co-founder and CEO of MyoMaster @myomaster, to find out how a homemade massage gun turned into a multimillion-pound business.

In 2020, Lottie launched MyoMaster alongside her husband, former England rugby player Joe Gray, creating recovery products including massage guns, ice baths and saunas.
Their big breakthrough came in 2024 when Lottie appeared on Dragons’ Den, securing an investment offer before ultimately deciding to turn it down.

The exposure helped fuel huge demand, with MyoMaster going on to generate £8M in annual revenue.
